source: scripts/data/trainers.defs.json checked against the OSRS Wiki (LocLine spawns, drop tables) and scripts/data/build-trainers.ts

trainers.name: cows

place.label: The cow field east of Lumbridge

trainers.goal: The cow field east of Lumbridge
trainers.where: The cow field north-east of Lumbridge Castle, across the river (Lumbridge cow field).

trainers.name: Minotaurs

place.label: The Stronghold of Security entrance, Barbarian Village mine

trainers.goal: Stronghold of Security floor 1: the level 12 Minotaurs

waypoints.label: The Stronghold of Security entrance: climb down
Floor 1 (Vault of War): the level 12 Minotaurs

trainers.where: The Stronghold of Security, floor 1 (the Vault of War): the level 12 Minotaurs (the level 27 ones are further in). The entrance is in the Barbarian Village mine. There is no bank on the floor: bank in Edgeville first.

trainers.name: Giant frogs
trainers.where: Fight level 13 Giant frogs on the surface of Lumbridge Swamp, south of Lumbridge Castle. Do not enter the caves: those frogs are level 99. Refill food at Lumbridge Castle bank.

trainers.name: Hill Giants

place.label: The trapdoor to the Edgeville Dungeon

waypoints.label: The trapdoor to the Edgeville Dungeon: climb down

trainers.where: The Hill Giants in the Edgeville Dungeon: the trapdoor is in Edgeville, a few steps south-west of the bank, and the giants are in the south-east of the dungeon. If you have a Brass key, the locked door by the giants saves the walk past the skeletons. The Edgeville bank is a minute away.

trainers.name: barbarians
trainers.where: The barbarians of Barbarian Village, around the long hall by the Stronghold of Security entrance. Most are level 10, a few level 17; none attack first. Bank in Edgeville, north along the road.

trainers.name: Al Kharid warriors
trainers.where: The warriors in the Al Kharid palace. When you attack one, the others nearby join in: pull one aside before fighting. The Al Kharid bank is just west of the palace.

trainers.name: monks
trainers.where: The monks on the ground floor of Edgeville Monastery, west of Edgeville. Instead of eating, talk to a monk and ask to be healed: 2 + 20% of your Hitpoints each time. Bank in Edgeville.

trainers.name: Brutus
trainers.where: Brutus in his pen in the north of the cow field east of Lumbridge, open after The Ides of Milk. Step aside when he winds up a charge or a stomp: they hit up to 19. He comes back about 22 seconds after each kill. Bank at Lumbridge Castle.
